step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram represents Contino's Flight Controller system, an extension to AWS Control Tower. Events triggered in Control Tower (via CodePipeline or Systems Manager) are published to EventBridge via CloudWatch event subscriptions. EventBridge invokes an AWS Lambda function that enriches and transforms the raw metadata. Lambda simultaneously persists raw historical event data into DynamoDB and time-series metrics into Amazon Timestream. Finally, Grafana queries Amazon Timestream to visualize real-time performance metrics and dashboards for SRE and DevOps teams.

graph.name: Contino Flight Controller Architecture
graph.notes: Flight Controller visualizes performance metrics and health checks of AWS Control Tower landing zones in under 20 seconds using a serverless event-driven architecture.

nodes.name: Control Tower
nodes.notes: AWS Control Tower defining and managing the AWS landing zone environment.

nodes.name: CodePipeline
nodes.notes: Runs deployment pipelines for account vending and workload provisioning.

nodes.name: Systems Manager
nodes.notes: Manages operational and patching events across the landing zone.

nodes.name: EventBridge
nodes.notes: Receives raw operational events from CloudWatch event subscriptions.

nodes.name: Lambda
nodes.notes: Transforms raw event payloads to extract key metadata such as triggered resource and timestamp.

nodes.name: DynamoDB
nodes.notes: Stores raw event data for historical retention and auditing.

nodes.name: Timestream
nodes.notes: Time-series database storing aggregated operational metrics.

nodes.name: Grafana
nodes.notes: Renders real-time dashboards and visualization metrics using SQL queries against Timestream.

edges.notes: Control Tower events (e.g. CodePipeline / Systems Manager execution) publish raw events to EventBridge.
EventBridge triggers Lambda function to process incoming raw event payload.
Lambda writes enriched raw event data into DynamoDB.
Lambda writes formatted time-series metrics into Timestream.
Grafana queries Timestream to display performance metrics on dashboards.
